Card Q&A.a: This card's [On Deletion] effect can play a play cost 4 or lower Digimon card that has the [NSp] trait or a play cost 4 or lower yellow Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What Digimon cards can be played using this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or has the [NSp] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
